# CWE-798: AWS access key ID — hardcoded credential.
# AKIA... is a live AWS key; anyone with it can call as that IAM user.
# The rule flags 20-char key IDs; ok lines are non-keys or short stubs.
# ruleid: detected-aws-access-key-id-value
AKIAIOSFODNN7EAXMPLE
# ruleid: detected-aws-access-key-id-value
ASIAIOSFODNN7EAXMPLE
# ok: detected-aws-access-key-id-value
not-a-key

AKIA123

AKIAZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ
# ruleid: detected-aws-access-key-id-value
ASIAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
# ok: detected-aws-access-key-id-value
